LPLA.summary: Financial advisor Dawn Parks, CFP®, CLU®, and her woman-owned firm Sunny Day Financial have joined LPL Financial's broker-dealer and RIA platforms. Following these disclosures, INNIO shares declined approximately 15% from its $27.00 IPO price to around $23, raising questions about whether the company misrepresented or failed to timely disclose material information to investors.

KLNG.title: KOIL Energy Announces Successful Commissioning of New Mobile Barge Carousel
KLNG.summary: KOIL Energy Solutions Inc. (OTCQB: KLNG) announced the successful commissioning of its newly acquired mobile barge-based carousel on the U.S. Gulf Coast. The asset has completed system integration testing and is ready for deployment on its first project expected to be completed in late September 2026. The company also reported successful start-up of an existing carousel following capacity modifications, strengthening its subsea umbilical handling and storage capabilities.

VCEL.title: Vericel Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results, Raises Full-Year Financial Guidance and Announces Share Repurchase Program

STN.title: Stantec joint venture selected by U.S. Army Corps of Engineers to advance coastal resilience on Charleston’s peninsula
STN.summary: Stantec and Johnson, Mirmiran and Thompson (JMT) have been awarded a US$150 million contract by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers to design coastal storm risk management infrastructure for Charleston's peninsula. The project, part of a US$1.2 billion total program, will involve designing over eight miles of integrated coastal infrastructure including storm surge barriers, floodwalls, levees, pump stations, and nature-based features to protect the historic community from increasing storm surge vulnerability.

CBIO.title: Crescent Biopharma Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Recent Business Highlights
CBIO.summary: Crescent Biopharma reported Q2 2026 results with continued enrollment in its ASCEND Phase 1/2 trial for CR-001, a PD-1 x VEGF bispecific antibody. The company completed a $143.7 million public offering extending cash runway to H2 2028 and announced multiple clinical data readouts expected beginning Q1 2027. R&D expenses increased to $19.4 million due to expanded clinical activities, while the company maintains strategic partnerships with Kelun-Biotech for development in Greater China.

RACE.title: PERSONALIZATIONS AND MIX CONTINUE TO DRIVE STRONG RESULTS AND 2026 GUIDANCE RAISE
RACE.summary: Ferrari N.V. announced Q2 2026 net revenues of €1,938 million (up 8% YoY), operating profit of €605 million with a 31.2% margin, and net profit of €463 million. The company raised its 2026 guidance citing stronger-than-expected personalizations and lower currency headwinds. The order book covers deliveries through 2027, with new model launches including the Ferrari Luce and 12Cilindri Manuale contributing to the company's most complete product lineup in history.

CSW.title: CSW Industrials Reports Impressive Fiscal 2027 First Quarter with All-Time Record Results; Contractor Solutions Segment Delivers Second Consecutive Quarter of Positive Organic Growth
CSW.summary: CSW Industrials reported record fiscal 2027 first quarter results with total revenue of $351 million (up 33%), adjusted EPS of $3.84 (up 35%), and adjusted EBITDA of $102 million (up 48%). The Contractor Solutions segment achieved 6% organic revenue growth for the second consecutive quarter. The company has invested $1 billion in five acquisitions since May 2025, including MARS Parts and Aspen Manufacturing, while maintaining a net leverage ratio of 2.37x within its target range.

RCAT.title: Red Cat Receives $2.49 Million U.S. Air Force Order for Black Widow Systems

RCAT.title: Red Cat Advances R&D and Innovation Strategy Following Successful Validation Event with Industry Partners
RCAT.summary: Red Cat Holdings announced advancement of its R&D and innovation strategy through SPiDRWORX, its dedicated innovation group, following a successful technology validation event in Salt Lake City. ISUNQ.title: eSUN Launches PLA-Coffee, a Sustainable 3D Printing Filament Made from Recycled Coffee Grounds
ISUNQ.summary: eSUN has commercially launched PLA-Coffee, an innovative bio-based 3D printing filament that combines repurposed coffee grounds with biodegradable PLA. The material addresses sustainability demands, reduces carbon footprint, and offers aesthetic advantages including a natural matte finish that conceals layer lines. The filament maintains compatibility with standard FDM 3D printers and is optimized for home decor and desktop applications.

VWAV.title: VisionWave Files U.S. Non-Provisional Patent Application for DeepWave RF™, an AI-Powered Subsurface Sensing and Visualization Platform
VWAV.summary: VisionWave Holdings has filed a non-provisional utility patent application for DeepWave RF™, an AI-powered subsurface sensing platform designed for drilling and geological exploration. The technology integrates software-defined radio, near-bit RF sensing, edge computing, and physics-informed artificial intelligence to provide drilling operators with anticipatory visibility into subsurface formations ahead of the drill bit. The system aims to improve geosteering, hazard detection, and drilling safety across oil and gas, geothermal, mineral exploration, and other subsurface industries.
